decision.reason: The only evidence is one CHANGELOG line, filed under the "Documentation:" section, saying ReferenceGrants were added to the Gateway API controller RBAC [ev-b93f05e6d823]. It does not say the controller fails, loses access or needs the permission to work, so permission-lost (action-required, high) is not supported. The line also does not show whether this is only a fix to the documented example RBAC, which would mean no impact or behavior-change. To decide, we need the PR #10462 diff or the Gateway API docs/upgrade notes showing whether the v3.0.0 controller watches ReferenceGrants and what happens when existing RBAC lacks that permission.
